title: Episode 5: The Mango Fever of 1968: When Mao's Fruit Became Sacred
description: In August 1968, Chairman Mao Zedong received a diplomatic basket of Pakistani mangoes and re-gifted them to factory workers in Beijing. What followed was one of the most surreal episodes in modern history: a nationwide frenzy of mango veneration, glass shrines, formaldehyde preservation, and wax fruit processions.
